checks: Anonymous visitors and other signed-in users cannot read drafts, publish changes or access the media editor.
Draft changes survive separate requests and leave the public storefront unchanged.
Published prices, product pages, copy, FAQs, metadata, new pages and sitemap update immediately; stale saves and unsafe links are rejected.
Order totals use published CMS prices; a client cannot spoof prices, and sold-out products cannot be added.
A published version restores to a draft and does not unexpectedly overwrite the live store.
Owner uploads persist in R2 and load with immutable caching; executable SVG uploads are rejected.
The hosted admin page checks owner identity before rendering the editor.
browserQA: See hosted-browser-verification.json. This suite uses built Worker/D1/R2 requests; no physical phone FPS or field Web Vitals claim.
